title: THE KLEIN PAIRS ARE DIRECTIONS — 6 axes of non-self locomotion

directions.ratio: how much you act vs how much you sing

directions.ratio: how much is data vs how much is beauty
directions.locomotion: sailing between raw data and rendered beauty

directions.ratio: how much you tell vs how much you listen
directions.locomotion: pushing forward with story or holding ground to receive

directions.ratio: how much you see vs how much you are seen
